api_changes.detail: The US-only page says to call https://us.api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions for a US model id. The quickstart shows POST https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions for other serverless models. This sample changes the model field and the host when the id is a US id.
The changelog says dedicated deployments are unaffected.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://us.api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="accounts/fireworks/routers/glm-5p3-flash-us",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://us.api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="accounts/fireworks/routers/deepseek-v4p1-flash-1017-us",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for accounts/fireworks/routers/glm-5p3-flash-us on the linked official page.
This row is the US endpoint only. The global endpoint is a different id.
Point your requests at accounts/fireworks/routers/deepseek-v4p1-flash-1017-us and test before you send traffic.
